title: voidsplash
description: A Hypixel SkyBlock resource pack that changes potion colors, primarily intended for splashing during Bingo Events
body:
## voidsplash
voidsplash is a 1.21.5+ Resource Pack for Hypixel SkyBlock that sets specific colors for 35 different obtainable and brewable potions to make an inventory full of potions look all the more clean and stylish.

To provide clarity, organization, and another layer of error-checking to brewing, this resource pack will lightly tint potions that are not at maximum duration (typically 1 hour for Alchemy 50). It does this using custom data set on the potion items themselves.

Additionally, the default Rainbow Pack features a split-color system for XP Boost Potions to aid with sorting them, using a secondary color associated with the skill to differentiate them.

The pack was created specifically to assist with god splashes during Bingo Events, as rainbow splashes look super nice in chat. It does not modify menu potions or potions without custom data.

![A Minecraft-inventory style 11x3 grid featuring 33 potions from the voidsplash Rainbow pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Oz9s9eGw/images/4fdf3a4bd229d656ba01f0eb18b6fea87624757f.png)

---

### ✰ Pack Variants

There are three variants of this pack available for download. Previews are linked in the gallery.
* **[Rainbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Oz9s9eGw/images/2e64c33ae073abcc63d7147528b0ae520eab1429.png)**: Sets an ordered rainbow gradient based on the below list of potions, including textures and secondary colors for XP Boosts.
* **[Color](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Oz9s9eGw/images/2c6c619a177fae041027707a9e933c6c96cefdf0.png)**: Sets a color palette based on the color of the potion effect text.
* **[Enums](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Oz9s9eGw/images/d279d188fc922442b6e3f7c71ae3d7c68b23efd2.png)**: Sets a color palette derived from the default Minecraft ENUM colors.

---

### ✰ Compatibility
This resource pack is made to work with versions of Minecraft 1.21.5 and above and does not require any additional mods to work. The game may indicate incompatibility with newer versions of Minecraft, but the pack will likely still work.

Due to Hypixel dropping SkyBlock support for <1.21.9 versions of Minecraft on February 24, 2026, the 1.8.9 and 1.21.5 versions are not available for download.
